name: Solitaire: Klondike & Spider
summary: Solitaire: Klondike & Spider is a collection of three classic patience card games: Klondike, in Draw 1 and Draw 3 variants with a choice of limited or unlimited passes; Spider, in one, two and four suits; and FreeCell, played from random hands or any of its one million numbered deals. Random deals in seven of the game's modes are drawn from a bundled catalogue of layouts a solver has already proven winnable, so every hand has a path to victory.
